name: Jev Continuation
description: The message a JevAgent's continuation appends to its main agent's loop when an enabled done check fails at a finish attempt. It hands the main agent the original request, run state, handoff, failed Jev questions, and focus, directing it to finish missing work or apply a concrete simplification while preserving requirements. Its placeholders are {request}, {run_state}, {handoff}, {failed}, and {focus}.
